# TC.InputConnectivity

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.InputConnectivity"></a>

### TC.InputConnectivity

This record gives the input connection state for the selected color.
Only the selected red or green field is present. The other field is absent.
Initial previous connectivity is false.

### green (optional)

Present only for green selection; physical connection status.

```text
boolean
```

### red (optional)

Present only for red selection; physical connection status.

```text
boolean
```
